subject: browse() leads to invisible firefox process

messages.author: 3d0cccc7ec805901
messages.subject: browse() leads to invisible firefox process
parts:
Hi all,

I have the following lines in a script:

s <- Rhttpd$new()
s$add(app=app, name="xyz")
s$start(quiet=TRUE)
s$browse("xyz")

When I send the lines to an R process within ESS (Emacs Speaks
Statistics) it works perfectly: firefox opens a new tab with the rook
application.

However, when I run these lines in an R process within a terminal or
within an Rscript (in a terminal), then nothing visible happens but
the firefox process is running invisibly. "ps ax" tells me:

2324 pts/4 Rl+ 0:02 /usr/lib/firefox-3.6.23/firefox-bin
-new-tab http://127.0.0.1:16603/custom/xyz

The problem is not rrook specific, I admit: same thing with
browseURL() or with system("xdg-open 'http://www.r-project.org'"). I
have no clue what happens here. I did several google searches without
success.

I would really like to use rrook not depending on ESS.

Any ideas?

I use R 2.13.1 on Ubuntu 10.10.

Sven

messages.author: 3d0cccc7ec805901
messages.subject: Re: browse() leads to invisible firefox process
parts:
Sorry, the ps output was the wrong one. It's "S" rather than "Rl+" in
the STAT column. The Rl+ one was a visible firefox process started
from within ESS. In case it makes a difference.

Sven
